ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Arihant Superstructures reported a 9% year-on-year increase in Q1 FY27 consolidated operating revenue to INR 132 crores, accompanied by strong operational growth including a 15% rise in sales bookings to INR 173 crores and a 28% jump in collections to INR 161 crores. The company is strategically focused on executing its substantial INR 14,000 crore Gross Development Value pipeline over the next 6-7 years, foregoing new land acquisitions this fiscal year to manage debt and costs, while aiming to improve its current 21% EBITDA margin through a higher contribution from premium projects and diversification into hospitality. Rising construction costs due to geopolitical factors remain a challenge, though management claims neutralization through existing inventory.
